newsitem.title: UK: OPTIONS - Dlr/yen vols soar as spot tumbles.
newsitem.headline: OPTIONS - Dlr/yen vols soar as spot tumbles.

text.p: Implied volatilities on dollar/yen options surged in Europe as spot accelerated its decline to more than four-month lows.
One-month dollar/yen vol shot to 12.0/12.5 percent by 1054 GMT from late Wednesday's European level of 9.9/10.4, with the entire volatility curve ramping up in sympathy.
Two-month vol climbed to 11.0/11.5 percent from 9.5/10.0, while one-year rose to 10.0/10.3 from 9.3/9.8.
"Attention switched from crosses to dollar/yen as spot tumbled on a yen rise and we saw a vicious spike up in one-month vols," said an options trader at a U.S. bank in London.
One-month risk reversals remained clearly skewed for yen calls at 0.7/1.2 percent.
Though traders said the focus had shifted from the crosses, a new slump in mark/yen to its weakest in a year saw vols harden there too.
One-month mark/yen vol firmed to 9.7/10.5 percent from late yesterday's 8.9/9.2, with six-month up to 8.3/8.8 from 8.0/8.2 and one-year to 8.1/8.6 percent from 7.9/8.15.
Risk reversals for 25-delta one-month options twisted even further in the yen's favour. Traders quoted them at 0.7/1.2 percent for mark calls versus 0.5/0.9 on Wednesday.
Dollar/mark was sidelined -- in both the spot and options markets -- by the yen's broad-based advance, though the U.S. currency's general nervousness trickled into vols.
One-month dollar/mark vol rose to 9.0/9.35 percent from Wednesday's European level of 8.65/8.85, with risk reversals retaining a narrow bias for mark calls at 0.1/0.4 percent.
